shots.visual_event: Tick collapses in the archive as twelve visible clockwork gears stop; a sealed thirteenth socket glows beneath his ivory chest plate.
shots.dialogue_audio: Meera: “He gave the station too much time.”

shots.visual_event: Maya opens an old tool case engraved E.D. / 1976; inside is a gear that matches Tick perfectly.
shots.dialogue_audio: Saira: “Who is E.D.?” Maya: “My brother Elias.”

shots.visual_event: Memory fragment: teenage Elias builds the small quadruped fox for child Maya, carefully notching its right ear.
shots.dialogue_audio: Elias in memory: “So you’re never alone at midnight.”

shots.visual_event: The Midnight Train comes for Maya after she survives a station roof collapse; Elias pushes her out and boards with Tick.
Present Maya installs the thirteenth gear. Tick’s cyan eyes relight and project every handwritten memory of Meera stored inside him.
shots.dialogue_audio: Maya: “He has remembered her for all of us.”

shots.visual_event: On the train, the Conductor feels Tick restart and grips the same E.D. engraving inside his glove.

end_card.text: MAYA’S BROTHER IS STILL ON THE TRAIN
